entities.summary: Pan Wenli is a retired Chinese female volleyball player. Pan was part of the Chinese women's national volleyball team that won the silver medal at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta. She also participated at the 1994 FIVB World Championship in Brazil, winning bronze medal.
